boundary.description: From the junction of the Manchester, Oldham and Tameside Metropolitan Boundaries at the River Medlock, westwards by the River Medlock to and along Bank Bridge Road and Ten Acres Lane to and along the Ashton under Lyne – Manchester railway to Oldham Road Bridge, then by Oldham Road and Thorp Road to and along the Manchester – Rochdale railway to and along St Mary’s Rd to and by Moston Brook to the Manchester and Oldham Metropolitan Boundary and by this boundary to the River Medlock.
